answer: The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. To join, a name must pass Dyebound journeyman fulling mill keeper soap seal, which works because a seal journeyman fulling mill keepers renew after fulling mill checks. Nobody is waved through free: £9 per docket, and 95 dockets before the first reward is released is the price, and the beacon never covers it twice. The pulse is checked, not assumed. One shale, one entry.
